description: This file defines the InstanceCreationController class which extends AbstractInstallerVueController. It handles the pre-render logic for the instance creation screen in an installer workflow within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. The method preRender initializes a Vue component for the interface and sets the current screen state.

classes.name: InstanceCreationController
classes.description: Controller class for managing the instance creation screen during the installation process of OrangeHRM.

methods.name: preRender
methods.description: Prepares the view by creating a Vue component for the instance creation screen and sets the current screen state.
